description: Manage Assured Platform residents, communities, and operational records.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Assured Platform account API key sent with the x-api-key header. Request a key from Assured Support at support@withassured.com; see https://developers.withassured.com/.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Get details for the user authenticated by the Assured Platform API key.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for retrieving the current Assured Platform user.

user.description: The authenticated user returned by Assured Platform.

outputSchema.description: The current Assured Platform user response.

actions.name: get_task
actions.description: Get detailed information about one Assured Platform task.

taskId.description: The UUID of the task to retrieve.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for retrieving an Assured Platform task.

task.description: One task returned by Assured Platform.

outputSchema.description: The Assured Platform task detail response.

actions.name: list_tasks
actions.description: List Assured Platform tasks with optional filtering and offset pagination.

limit.description: The maximum number of tasks to return.

search.description: The text used to search tasks.

status.description: The task status used to filter results.

taskType.description: The task type used to filter results.

assigneeId.description: The UUID of the task assignee.

clientId.description: The UUID of the client associated with the task.

facilityId.description: The UUID of the facility associated with the task.

createdAtAfter.description: Return tasks created at or after this timestamp.

createdAtBefore.description: Return tasks created at or before this timestamp.

dueOnAfter.description: Return tasks due at or after this timestamp.

dueOnBefore.description: Return tasks due at or before this timestamp.

ordering.description: The documented Assured Platform ordering expression.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for listing Assured Platform tasks.

count.description: The total number of matching tasks.

anyOf.description: The URL for the next result page when one exists.

next.description: The URL for the next result page when one exists.

anyOf.description: The URL for the previous result page when one exists.

previous.description: The URL for the previous result page when one exists.

items.description: One task returned by Assured Platform.

tasks.description: The tasks returned for this page.

outputSchema.description: The paginated Assured Platform task list.
